Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only dark ground. Above it a clear night sky full of stars, deep navy shading to black, a faint milky way, and a bright moon in the left third two thirds of the way up the sky. A low glow of cool white floodlight haze lies along the whole horizon, with soft shafts of floodlight rising from it at intervals, and a dark line of trees and scattered far city lights on the horizon itself. No stadium, no buildings in front. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
